title: Vigil edge containment-policy pack v1
description: The payload of an edge-policy DSSE envelope: what a Warden node may enforce while partitioned. Parsed only after the envelope's signature has verified (core/edge/verify.py). Every field set is closed (additionalProperties: false) so an unknown field is a rejection, not a silent extra.

indicator.description: The alert entity a rule matches on. v1 ships the IP indicator only — it is what the v1 executor can act on.

action_type.description: v1 ships one local executor (nftables block_ip in the vigil_warden table); the DryRun fallback takes the same type. Extending this enum is how a new executor ships.

node_selector.description: A "key:value" segment label, e.g. "segment:dmz" — which nodes the pack applies to.

protected_target.description: Target classes the pre-executor guard refuses before any executor runs (self-lockout is impossible by construction).

ttl_minutes.description: How long the block lives on its own; hard-capped by the envelope's max_action_ttl_minutes.

min_local_confidence.description: Local confidence a match must reach; the effective floor is max(this, the envelope's confidence_floor).

autonomy_envelope.description: The hard ceiling on local enforcement, signed into the pack — not configurable at the edge, not DB-overridable. The decision engine refuses anything outside it.

max_actions_per_hour.description: The hourly rate cap. 0 is valid: an envelope that allows nothing.

require_reversible.description: True: an irreversible action never enforces, whatever a rule says.

confidence_floor.description: Local confidence at or above which a rule match acts. NaN/Infinity are refused at JSON parse.

allow_slm_decisions.description: False (default): the local SLM ranks advisory-only; rules alone decide.

model_manifest.description: Present: the local SLM this pack was built for — warden verifies the on-disk model file against this sha256 before loading it. Absent: rules-only triage. Model files are never committed or fetched here; only their identity travels.

policy_version.description: Monotonic per node: a node holding vN refuses vN-1, and re-presented vN must hash to the payload bytes it already holds.

not_after.description: Fail-closed: at this instant live actions are undone and the node drops to PASSIVE — stale authority never enforces.

rules.description: May be empty: a pack that only ratchets the envelope down.
